candidates.sentence: He will fight against the reckless spending that is causing 40-year record inflation, rein in out-of-control gas prices by unleashing American energy and will restore law and order to our communities by backing the blue and securing our border.
Uphold free speech, protect the lives of unborn children and their mothers, guarantee religious freedom, and safeguard the Second Amendment.
He will be an unwavering defender of our US Constitution and protecting the Second Amendment.
Secure the Border and Combat Illegal Immigration
End special treatment for Members of Congress by repealing proxy voting, and increase accountability in the election process through voter ID, accurate voter rolls, and observer access.

Langworthy wanted to take his drive to protect taxpayers even further and was elected to serve as the Erie County Republican Chairman where he helped elect strong leaders to every level of government.
